translations.web: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. He who overcomes won’t be harmed by the second death.
translations.bsb: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. The one who overcomes will not be harmed by the second death.
translations.kjv: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; He that overcometh shall not be hurt of the second death.
translations.asv: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith to the churches. He that overcometh shall not be hurt of the second death.
